description_en: Describes the syntax and examples of the FaceBeauty operation in the facebody category
description_zh: 本文介绍人脸人体（facebody）类目下的人脸美颜FaceBeauty的语法及示例
name: FaceBeauty

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the image. Use an OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region. For files stored locally or in OSS buckets outside the China (Shanghai) region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.
Input limits:

Image format: JPEG, JPG, PNG, and BMP.
Image size: up to 4 MB.
Image resolution: The resolution must be greater than 10 × 10 pixels and less than 2000 × 2000 pixels. The longest side must be less than 2000 pixels.
The URL cannot contain Chinese characters.
Image quality recommendations: Suitable for portrait images of most skin types. The effect may be average for images with severe spots, acne, or underexposure
parameters.help_zh:
图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。
输入限制：

图像格式：JPEG、JPG、PNG、BMP。
图像大小：不超过4 MB。
图像分辨率：分辨率大于10×10像素，分辨率小于2000x2000像素，最长边小于2000像素。
URL地址中不能包含中文字符。
图像质量建议：适用于大部分肤质的人像图像，对于包含比较严重色斑、痤疮或低曝等场景的图像效果一般
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: The sharpening (clarity) level. Valid values: 0 to 1. A value closer to 1 indicates a higher sharpening level
parameters.help_zh: 锐化（清晰度）程度，取值范围0~1。越接近1锐化程度越高
parameters.name: sharp

parameters.help_en: The smoothing level. Valid values: 0 to 1. A value closer to 1 indicates a higher smoothing level
parameters.help_zh: 平滑程度，取值范围0~1。越接近1平滑程度越高
parameters.name: smooth

parameters.help_en: The skin whitening level. Valid values: 0 to 1. A value closer to 1 indicates a higher skin whitening level
parameters.help_zh: 美白程度，取值范围0~1。越接近1美白程度越高
parameters.name: white

ImageURL.description_en:
The URL of the retouched image.
This URL is temporary and valid for 30 minutes. It becomes inaccessible after it expires. To store the file for a long time or permanently, access the URL and download the file to your OSS bucket or other storage space within 30 minutes
ImageURL.description_zh:
美颜后图像的URL地址。
该URL地址为临时地址，有效期为30分钟，过期后将无法访问。若需要长时间或者永久保存文件，请在30分钟内访问URL地址，下载文件转存到自己的OSS或者其他存储空间
